nodes.label: F5-TTS Transformation Sensitivity Experiment
nodes.description: Three-panel transformation experiment on F5-TTS lip-sync model. (1) Gain sensitivity: higher gain improves SyncC but minimal SyncD effect. (2) Frequency cutoff: low-pass 3000Hz severely degrades SyncD (+1.381), 8000Hz improves SyncC. (3) SyncD change from baseline bar chart. n=5 per condition, ±1σ error bars.

findings.gain: Higher gain improves perceptual sync (SyncC), slight improvement in objective sync (SyncD); -10dB severely degrades SyncD (+0.625)
findings.frequency: Low-pass 3000Hz worst degradation (+1.381 ΔSyncD); high frequencies essential for lip-sync; trade-off between SyncC and SyncD with bandwidth

nodes.label: F5-TTS
nodes.description: F5-TTS lip-sync model evaluated in transformation sensitivity experiments. Features prominently in spectrogram comparison, case study, and transformation experiments.
